messages.subject: R-INLA benchmarks
parts:
Dear R-INLA users,

Has someone produced any kind of benchmark for R-INLA? What I am looking for is a comparison of computation time (and, perhaps, memory usage) for different latent models in R-INLA on the size of the dataset.

If such a benchmark is not available, I will be happy to produce one for some latent effects available in R-INLA. Comments on how to proceed are welcome!

Best regards,

Virgilio
